scope: Current 59-symbol/57-populated A-P4 PDB release model feeding the Osiris Rev A behavioral surrogate; older populations remain historical.

engine.why_not_pspice: The user selected the installed free LTspice for this verification run.
engine.dialect_warning: Decks use LTspice-only constructs (B-sources, tanh/limit/if, Rser= on caps, .step param, table()). They will NOT run in PSpice without translation.

models.provenance: User-supplied Infineon 100 V archive; library version 240725
models.limits: BSC070N10NS5_L1, original parameters and package parasitics. Fixed simulation temperature, no self-heating. Previous fitted-Q3 results are historical pending rerun.

models.provenance: ST_POWER_SCHOTTKY_V10.LIB inside user-supplied resources.zip / st_power_schottky_diodes_pspice_models_v6.zip; original retained in Simulation/vendor-models/received-20260917/st-schottky
models.pin_order: 1 anode, 2 cathode, 3 anode; both anodes to GND, cathode to VOUT
models.limits: No thermal network, SOA or reverse breakdown BV parameter. Does not establish pulse survival. Replaces the fitted STPST10H100_SCREEN model in the release population only.

models.pin_order: VIN UV OV RETRY GND SHDN FAULT VOUT SENSE GATE
1 OUT, 2 ADJ, 3 NC, 4 GND, 5 SHDN, 6 NC, 7 NC, 8 IN
models.limits: Vendor model, nominal reference 1.275 V. Out-of-range behavior remains unqualified. Phantom external current sinks were removed; do not infer hardware reverse or transient protection from this model alone.

models.provenance: User-supplied Infineon 60 V simulation library, version 030726; exact ISC015N06NM5LF2_L1 subcircuit
models.limits: Constant device temperature from TEMP, default typical process parameters, vendor package parasitics retained. No self-heating in L1. Five-pin electrothermal variant is available but requires application thermal boundary conditions. Historical surrogate results do not validate this updated model.
BV 28.1 V and Rdyn 1.4 ohm from VBR/VC datasheet points; Cjo estimated, not measured.

Cold resistor only (23.48/17.75 mOhm assumptions carried from older source). No heating/opening/arcing/clearing. Old 17/25 A^2s figures are not acceptance limits. Use current manufacturer time-current data and temperature derating for coordination.
Supply draw and input impedance only. NO ADC, NO I2C, NO register map, NO alert logic. Says nothing about measurement accuracy or alert timing.
No propagation delay, no output slew shaping.

models.provenance: Pre-existing engineering surrogate in this repo, self-labelled 'not a TI model'
models.limits: Engineering surrogate, no thermal/fast-trip model. TI SNOSDC0A table 6.7 supports typical open-pin SR=28.1 V/ms and TD=0.1 ms at 12 V; slew varies with input (12.14 V/ms at 2.7 V, 44.78 V/ms at 23 V). A fixed 12 V typical is not a guaranteed bound.

models.provenance: Behavioral average; AP64501 DS41980 Rev 5-2 reviewed.
models.limits: 0.8 V reference and 570 kHz verified in manufacturer datasheet. 100 nF soft-start maps to 18.868 ms using Eq.7, replacing 2 ms. IQ/EFF/ILIM/smoothed UVLO and bandwidth remain assumptions. No switching, compensation, peak-current or thermal qualification. Output delivery now requires enable and input headroom.
Regulation, dropout and pass-through current only. Only U12 (+3V3_AON) is instantiated as a node; the rest are folded into aggregate rail loads.

models.device: All Osiris digital consumers (Jetson, STM32H743, radios, USB hub, Ethernet bridge)
models.limits: Planning loads, not independent measured budgets. Boot ramp now starts after rail rise and resets on collapse. The 50% Jetson step at 600 ms is an arbitrary stress stimulus. Sequencer firmware and actual module demands remain unknown.

known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: DIGILOAD rail-collapse guard was applied to the pre-ramp value, so the 25 ms ramp kept sinking ~0.46 A from a dead rail and drove +5V0_PROT to -349 V, which then made the U4 pass element attempt ~12 kA.
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Guard now multiplies the final drawn current.
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.found_by: Recovery measurement returning a physically impossible negative voltage.

known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Hard if()/> comparators in BGO, BSEQ, BEN3/BEN5 chattered when rails decayed through threshold, collapsing the timestep to ~1e-15 and hanging the OV case (5817 tolerance warnings).
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Smoothed with tanh. Transition widths are NUMERICAL softening, not modelled hysteresis.

measurement_artifacts_encountered: `.meas INTEG ABS(ddt(...))` edge-counting returned 0 while the circuit was demonstrably oscillating. Superseded by direct min/max/avg over disjoint time windows. Do not trust ddt-based edge counts in these decks.
A 1.5 s fault window was too short to distinguish 'does not recover' from 'has not recovered yet'; the LTC4368 retry alone is ~545 ms. Extended to 3 s.
not_modelled: Fuse opening, arcing, clearing time, interrupt capability
Buck switching ripple and control-loop stability
All digital/firmware behaviour on both boards
PCB parasitics, trace resistance/inductance, thermal coupling
Component tolerance corners (single nominal values used throughout except where swept)
Osiris J24/J25 Module Hub pins 14/16/18/20, which tap raw VIN and allow unbudgeted external draw
review: 2026-09-15 independent model and schematic audit; see REVIEW.md and audit/verification.json.
current_schematic_model: pdb/pdb_release.lib; A-P4 LTC4359/Q3 front end, sensor filters, 5 mOhm shunt, 4 A fuse and DNP local I2C pull-ups.
review_fixes: No supply-independent INA228/buffer/AMS1117 quiescent sinks at zero power.
Buck cannot source through disabled/absent input in the averaged model.
Short I^2t includes switch edge at 899.96 ms.
Removed unreliable ddt-based edge counter; stable cases no longer require nonexistent retry crossings.
Native Windows runner checks completion, return codes, fresh logs, finite measurements and explicit electrical bounds.
